Review of Marlow Green Grocers

By Dora Halvorsen
2/5

After scrolling through the store options on the FreshRun app, I selected a cheese from Marlow Green Grocers. I had never used this shop before, but the reviews were mostly favourable. However, the cheese wasn’t as good as I had hoped. It was dry at the edges and had very little bite. The baked item I ordered was quite pleasant and cost only $5.20, but I have just noticed that it is no longer shown on the shop’s online catalogue. I suppose that product is not sold anymore. I was also a little irritated that the shop took so long to gather my order. The FreshRun app showed that it was ready for the shopper to collect at 1:15 P.M., nearly 40 minutes after I had placed the order. I definitely would not recommend this shop to anyone.
